verdict.rationale: AI Gateway lets you issue multiple team-owned API keys or use auto-provisioned OIDC tokens for Vercel deployments, and each key can carry its own spend budget and its own usage and request reporting. That gives some per-agent limitation and attribution. However, keys belong to the whole team, and nothing shows permission scoping such as limits by model, provider, project or endpoint. Missing for 10: per-key permission or model/provider scoping, key expiry or rotation controls for agent keys, explicit least-privilege documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
